9900001 - How to handle HANA Alert 54: 'Savepoint Duration'

Symptom

Test text. The savepoint check reports long durations. At the same time Alert ID 39 may show blocked transactions.

Open the alert in HANA Studio or with transaction DBACOCKPIT. See SAP Note 9900002 and KBAs 9900004, 9900005 for background.

Environment

SAP HANA Database

Product

SAP HANA, platform edition, all versions

Keywords

HANA Alert, Savepoint, KBA, HAN-DB-PER, SAP HANA Persistence, SV-PERF, Performance Problems, How To
